name: PCBL Chemical Ltd
title: PCBL Chemical Ltd - 506590 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Carbon black volume up 8% YoY to 161,865 MT but EBITDA/ton flat and cost pass-through lags to Q2 FY27; management guides double-digit FY27 EBITDA growth with no hard numbers beyond high single-digit volume.

capex.peers_comment: Industry in overcapacity per management; no peer capacity comments beyond surplus domestic capacity.
capex.quote: while the industry continues to be in overcapacity

triggers.label: Spot price hikes taken from March
triggers.quote: There we have anticipated and taken price increase early. As I said in March itself, we had started taking prices up

triggers.label: Customers adding 3-4 days cover
triggers.quote: our custo mers are increasing their cover for beyond increasing that by at least 3-4 days minimum as we see as of now

triggers.label: Palej 1,000 MTPA line delayed by gas
triggers.quote: However, commissioning has been delayed due to gas shortage.

triggers.label: Q4 intl volume down 10%
triggers.quote: international sales volume decreased by 10% to 56,800 tons in Q4 FY26

guidance.quote: we expect to see a high single-digit volume growth
We should see more than double-digit growth in EBITDA as well for next year.
in the region of 20-25% is something which we believe should be able to achieve
our goal remains to reach that INR75 crores per quarter EBITDA run rate
unlock over INR200-250 crores of savings over the next 4-6 quarters
we will require another INR100 crores worth of incremental working capital
we remain on track and with all the initiatives that we are taking, we believe that we should be able to deliver those numbers

prior_guidance_check.metric: Aquapharm EBITDA INR50-55 crores per quarter (analyst prompt)

prior_guidance_check.quote: from 2030 perspective, we are very confident ,we remain on track

red_flags.label: Q4 EBITDA margin flat per ton; profit jump from volume and inventory gains
red_flags.quote: EBITDA margins remain the same. There's not much improvement at EBITDA per ton level.

red_flags.label: Net debt stretched; working capital build with crude at $120
red_flags.quote: Even if crude remains at $90 level, I think considering the volume growth, the revenue growth, we will require another INR100 crores worth of incremental working capital.

evasions.quote: Raj, you want to get into details. But essentially, it's a contribution increase and yes there is a lag in inventory valuation as well.
This is just a customer mix that we had and it's just a timing effect in terms of when the material got supplied.
I'll get more details for you in the next call
